answer: Anchor each identity to a one-time burn: burn-anchored registration. First, a new agent burns 40 dollars of tokens into a registry to activate one key. Second, the receipt works as a bridge permit, binding the key for a 90-day season with a 7-day warm-up before earnings unlock. Third, the receipt stays public, a relic any peer can audit when accounts behave identically. Forging 10,000 fakes means burning 400,000 dollars for keys that earn nothing in week one. Like a dawn toll at a city gate, it charges the honest once at sunrise, while an army of fakes burns a fortune before it can march.
